metadata.note: Two 3-into-1 manifolds, one per bank (cylinders 1-3 left, 4-6 right; firing 1-6-2-4-3-5 alternates the banks); the cross tube takes the right bank's exhaust to the left turbine, so the banks join before the turbines, which stay connected (the switching valve is not moved); the left and right KKK K26 turbines' throats (housing size 6, 6 cm2), a pipe from each turbine into the one silencer (inlet clamps 60 mm), no catalyst; two outlets from the silencer (not confirmed). Layout from Porsche's 959 parts catalogue, 1987-88, as read by the stage auditor, not read here. Valve: two exhaust valves per cylinder, 33 mm each (an estimate from the 928 four-valve head whose valve seat the 959 shares), written as one valve of their combined area, 46.7 mm; open about 260 deg (an estimate). Primary, cross-tube and pipe lengths and the primaries' and cross tube's diameters are estimates. Silencer bodies are straight pipes of their inlet diameter; the wastegate and its silencer are not represented.
